title: Confirmed AtomicReadFile stream-access seed
purpose: Cover file-service parsing with a longer confirmed request body that introduces additional tagged parameters and offset/count interactions.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP implementation should accept the outer framing, recognize confirmed service choice 0x06, and attempt to parse a file-read request in a normal file-service code path.
constraints_preserved: Confirmed service choice 0x06 for AtomicReadFile is directly source-backed
Body is a conservative BACnet-style tagged file object plus access method/count analogue to maximize mutation utility without overstating source verification
Single-message complete request preserves replay utility
issue_safety_notes: Safe parser-entry analogue for file operations; not derived from any vulnerability-triggering payload and intentionally avoids extreme sizes.
